blocks.content: We, the People of India, having solemnly resolved to constitute India into a Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic and to secure to all its citizens: Justice, Liberty, Equality and Fraternity.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Constitution of India is the supreme legal document setting out the framework for government institutions, fundamental rights, and duties.
The Constituent Assembly spent nearly three years drafting the legal framework of independent India.
Dr. B.R. Ambedkar headed the Drafting Committee, playing a pivotal role as the chief architect of the Constitution.
It combines both rigidity and flexibility, allowing amendments while safeguarding the basic structure.
The Objective Resolution moved by Jawaharlal Nehru on December 13, 1946, served as the foundation for the Preamble.
November 26 is commemorated annually as Constitution Day (Samvidhan Divas).
The basic structure doctrine limits the amending power of Parliament under Article 368.

blocks.content: The 42nd Amendment aimed to reduce the workload of High Courts and ensure faster justice through specialized bodies.
